title: Sleep Training Approaches
learningGoal: Teach parents different sleep training methods and how to choose an approach that fits their child.
microLesson: Sleep training includes gentle methods, gradual withdrawal, and routine‑based approaches. The best method depends on the child’s temperament and the parent’s comfort. Consistency and calmness are key to success.
activity: Choose one sleep strategy to try for two nights. Reflect on how your child responded.
